author: AcidMelv420
body: The arisen version is a rly good support staff for horde dungeons or raiding, depending how you adorn it. It has high mag, a lot adornment slots and the buffs with a 1% proc rate per enemy hit / action done

author: thassnotmyname
body:
I love this staff and use it for a couple different builds as a mage. 
It's part of my loadout for speedfarming, since the buff chance is forgiving in hordes. The adornment slots make my Phoenix buff me more often, too.
